description: MainActivity.java for an Android Wearable app, managing data, images, and device connections via GoogleApiClient, with UI components including a view pager and fragments.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity managing wearable data, images, and device connections with UI components.

classes.name: MyPagerAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for managing fragments in the view pager.

classes.name: LoadBitmapAsyncTask
classes.description: AsyncTask for loading Bitmap images from Asset objects.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets up views, and builds GoogleApiClient.

methods.name: onConnected
methods.description: Handles successful connection to GoogleApiClient, adds listeners.

methods.name: onDataChanged
